title: Инсталационен агент — първично стартиране
purpose: Изпълнява реалната миграция при първо стартиране: заключва локалното състояние, документира инсталатора в AGENTS.md и добавя CI проверка за самия пакет.

params.content:
# >>> pasevsu-installer
# Локално състояние на инсталационния агент — никога не се комитва.
.installer/
# <<< pasevsu-installer

<!-- pasevsu-installer:start -->

## Installer agent

`installer/` contains `pasevsu-installer-agent` — a stdlib-only Python package that
performs the first-run migration of this repository and publishes the result.

```bash
python -m pasevsu_installer status
python -m pasevsu_installer install --dry-run
python -m pasevsu_installer install
```

Contract:

- Only agents that declare an explicit change task in `installer/agents/*.json` are executed.
- A verified backup (`installer-backup-*` git tag plus manifest) is taken before the first mutation.
- Every required suite from `installer/installer.config.json` must pass before publishing.
- Publishing commits to `installer/<version>` (never to `master`) and tags `installer-v<version>`.

<!-- pasevsu-installer:end -->

changes.note: Никога не презаписва AGENTS.md — само добавя маркиран блок.

params.content:
---
name: installer-agent

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "installer/**"
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "installer/**"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  unit:
    name: installer unit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Compile package
        run: python -m compileall -q installer/pasevsu_installer

      - name: Unit tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -s installer/tests -t installer -v

changes.note: Пакетът е без зависимости, затова CI не инсталира нищо.
